title: Validate commands before publication
lead: A synthetic example of keeping command admission ahead of publication.
changes: Check each command before it reaches the publication queue.
Keep rejected commands local and explain the decision.

sections.title: Move admission ahead of publication
sections.reason: These routes and outcomes are illustrative, not a reviewed PR or passing gate.

before.source:
flowchart LR
A[Receive command] -->|enqueue| B[Publish command]
B --> C[Check policy]
D[Rejected command]
before.description: The old illustrative route checks policy after publication.
steps: Check the policy too late to prevent publication.

after.source:
flowchart LR
A[Receive command] -->|check| B[Validate command]
B -->|allow| C[Publish command]
B -->|deny| D[Keep local]
after.description: The new illustrative route admits commands before publication.
steps: Check its policy before adding it to the queue.
Publish an admitted command; retain a rejected command locally.

sections.title: Keep the decision before the side effect
sections.reason: Synthetic messages show ordering, not an execution result.

before.source:
sequenceDiagram
participant A as Handler
participant B as Queue
A->>+B: publish
B-->>-A: queued
before.description: The handler publishes without an admission decision.
steps: Ask the queue to publish the command.

after.source:
sequenceDiagram
participant A as Handler
participant G as Admission gate
participant B as Queue
A->>+G: validate
G-->>-A: admitted
A->>+B: publish
B-->>-A: queued
after.description: The handler waits for admission before contacting the queue.
steps: Wait for the illustrative admitted response.
